scope_runner.py.content:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,time,datetime
D=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def now():return datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
def memory(tag):
 raw=Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text()
 a=int(next(l.split()[1] for l in raw.splitlines() if l.startswith('MemAvailable:')))
 with (D/'resources.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(dict(time=now(),tag=tag,available_kib=a,meminfo=raw,loadavg=Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text()))+'\n')
 return a
def run(spec,heavy=False):
 a=memory('start '+str(spec))
 if a<(14680064 if heavy else 4194304):raise RuntimeError('memory admission failed')
 unit='afdo-p9-reconvert-'+str(time.time_ns())
 cmd=['nice','-n','19','ionice','-c3','systemd-run','--user','--scope','--unit='+unit,'-p','MemoryMax='+('10G' if heavy else '3G'),'-p','CPUQuota='+('400%' if heavy else '200%'),'python3',str(D/'child.py'),str(spec)]
 log=Path(str(spec)+'.scope.log')
 t=time.monotonic();cg=None;peak=0;last=time.monotonic();low=0;event=None
 with log.open('w') as f:
  p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  while p.poll() is None:
   if cg is None:
    s=subprocess.run(['systemctl','--user','show',unit+'.scope','-p','ControlGroup','--value'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if s.stdout.strip():cg=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup'+s.stdout.strip())
   if cg:
    try:peak=max(peak,int((cg/'memory.peak').read_text()))
    except (FileNotFoundError,ValueError):pass
   if time.monotonic()-last>=60:
    a=memory('running '+unit);last=time.monotonic()
    low=low+1 if a<(3145728 if heavy else 2621440) else 0
    action='TERM' if (heavy and low>=2) or (not heavy and a<1572864) else ('STOP' if not heavy and low>=2 else None)
    if action:
     subprocess.run(['systemctl','--user','kill','--signal='+action,unit+'.scope'],capture_output=True)
     event=action;break
   time.sleep(.25)
  if event=='STOP':
   result=dict(scope=unit,event=event,peak_cgroup_bytes=peak)
   Path(str(spec)+'.scope.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
   raise RuntimeError('resource pause: scope remains stopped '+unit)
  rc=p.wait()
 result=dict(scope=unit,command=cmd,rc=rc,seconds=time.monotonic()-t,peak_cgroup_bytes=peak,event=event)
 s=subprocess.run(['systemctl','--user','show',unit+'.scope','-p','Result','-p','MemoryPeak','-p','OOMPolicy'],capture_output=True,text=True);result['systemd_after']=s.stdout
 Path(str(spec)+'.scope.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
 memory('end '+unit)
 if rc or event:raise RuntimeError('task failure '+str(result))
 return result

from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,traceback
from scope_runner import run,now,memory
from compare import sha
W=Path.cwd();D=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
rows=[];ok=False;reason=None
try:
 assert sha(W/'temp/llvm-profgen-enh/build/bin/llvm-profgen')=='2e8895afce661b5fdc8cacab2b3323496fca51af7bd7b51c3753aa8328b7d0d5'
 xs=json.loads((W/'temp/board-round1-retry/final-reconverted.json').read_text())['runs'];assert len(xs)==106
 for i,x in enumerate(xs):
  out=D/'outputs'/Path(x['source']).name;out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  if not (out/'comparison.json').exists():
   cmd=[('--output='+str(out/'profile.extbinary')) if s.startswith('--output=') else ('--quality-report='+str(out/'quality.json')) if s.startswith('--quality-report=') else s for s in x['command']]
   spec=out/'command.json';spec.write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=cmd,stdout=str(out/'stdout'),stderr=str(out/'stderr'),result=str(out/'run.json')),indent=2));run(spec)
   spec=out/'check-command.json';spec.write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=['python3',str(D/'compare_cli.py'),str(i)],stdout=str(out/'check.stdout'),stderr=str(out/'check.stderr'),result=str(out/'check-run.json')),indent=2));run(spec)
  z=json.loads((out/'comparison.json').read_text());rows.append({k:v for k,v in z.items() if k!='JSON_differences'})
  (D/'sample-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(completed=len(rows),moved_samples=sum(r['moved_samples'] for r in rows),runs=rows),indent=2))
  print(now(),'COMPLETE',i+1,Path(x['source']).name,'moved',z['moved_samples'],flush=True)
 assert sum(r['moved_samples'] for r in rows)==2736
 ok=True
except BaseException as e:
 reason=repr(e);traceback.print_exc()
finally:
 (D/'status.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(end=now(),status='OK' if ok else 'FAILED',completed=len(rows),reason=reason),indent=2))
 print('已结束',now(),'成功' if ok else '失败','ALL-END',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import json,traceback
from scope_runner import run,now
W=Path.cwd();D=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;rows=[];ok=False;reason=None
try:
 xs=json.loads((W/'temp/board-round1-retry/final-reconverted.json').read_text())['runs']
 for i,x in enumerate(xs):
  old=Path(x['output_directory'])
  if not (old/'profile-period.extbinary').exists():continue
  out=D/'outputs'/Path(x['source']).name
  cmd=[('--output='+str(out/'profile-period.extbinary')) if s.startswith('--output=') else ('--quality-report='+str(out/'quality-period.json')) if s.startswith('--quality-report=') else '--ip-weight=period' if s=='--ip-weight=sample' else s for s in x['command']]+['--ip-period-unit=1000003']
  spec=out/'period-command.json';spec.write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=cmd,stdout=str(out/'period.stdout'),stderr=str(out/'period.stderr'),result=str(out/'period-run.json')),indent=2));run(spec)
  spec=out/'period-check-command.json';spec.write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=['python3',str(D/'compare_cli.py'),str(i),'period'],stdout=str(out/'period-check.stdout'),stderr=str(out/'period-check.stderr'),result=str(out/'period-check-run.json')),indent=2));run(spec)
  z=json.loads((out/'comparison-period.json').read_text());rows.append({k:v for k,v in z.items() if k!='JSON_differences'})
  (D/'period-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(completed=len(rows),runs=rows),indent=2))
  print(now(),'COMPLETE',len(rows),Path(x['source']).name,flush=True)
 assert len(rows)==20
 ok=True
except BaseException as e:
 reason=repr(e);traceback.print_exc()
finally:
 (D/'period-status.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(end=now(),status='OK' if ok else 'FAILED',completed=len(rows),reason=reason),indent=2))
 print('已结束',now(),'成功' if ok else '失败','ALL-END',flush=True)
